title: Crash Detector public envelope
description: CLOSED. BLUEPRINT §3.4, §7 and §8; PID doctrine §3.1 and §3.5. additionalProperties is false at EVERY level and properties is an allowlist, so a key nobody declared cannot be published even if something computed it. There is no place in this document for a third, combined number: an envelope carrying combined_stress, overall, blended_score or anything else outside the allowlist is rejected by this schema alone, whatever route produced it. $id is a urn on purpose: a urn cannot be dereferenced, so no validator can be induced to fetch it. Every $ref is a local # fragment for the same reason. LIMIT, STATED RATHER THAN LEFT TO BE DISCOVERED: this schema constrains the SHAPE of what is published, so it refuses a blended number that arrives under a new key. It cannot see a blended number assigned to equity_crash.score, because that key is legitimately a number. That case is refused by the two other independent instruments — the score types define no arithmetic dunder and share no numeric base, and the register's AST no-blend check flags a single expression consuming both dial types (BLUEPRINT §13, three refusals for CD-AC-002, none load-bearing alone). detail_level IS NOW PRESENT, AND IT ATTACHES PER DIAL INSIDE $defs/dial_reading — NEVER AT THIS TOP LEVEL. PO-DECISIONS-0025 ruling 5 ruled Q29; the placement is doctrine, because one envelope-level level derived from both readings is the CD-AC-002 shape reached one step sideways. schema_version was bumped 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 for that allowlist edit, which is exactly the friction intended. STILL DELIBERATELY ABSENT AND OWED: the series and slope block (CD-AC-011, WO-4), the rotation-readiness ratio (CD-AC-013, WO-6), the wave-transition indicator (CD-AC-016, WO-6) and the witness panel section, which is a SEPARATE row written by a different role from a different pipeline and joined only at the serving layer (BLUEPRINT §6). Each addition is a deliberate allowlist edit with a schema_version bump, which is exactly the friction intended.

schema_version.description: Pinned by const. A consumer that reads this document knows exactly which allowlist it was validated against, and widening the allowlist without bumping this is a schema edit that fails its own test.

as_of_utc.description: The instant the READING is for — as fresh as its oldest input, never as fresh as the last time we asked.

published_utc.description: The instant this envelope was written. Distinct from as_of_utc so a consumer can see a publication pipeline that is running while the data behind it has stopped.

regime.description: The observed regime that selected the staleness window (BLUEPRINT §7, CD-AC-009). Constrained here to a non-empty string and NOT to an enumeration: naming the regimes is product meaning and is owed with CD-AC-009 in WO-3. An invented enumeration would be a scale nobody ratified.

staleness_window_seconds.description: The window that was applied, carried so every consumer judges freshness by the same declared rule rather than by its own guess. Strictly positive: an unbounded window is no window.

inputs_used.description: Registry source_ids that contributed. Empty is legal and is the WO-2 state.

degraded_inputs.description: Registry source_ids that were expected and were missing, stale or non-OK. Required even when empty, so a consumer never has to distinguish 'no degradation' from 'the field was omitted'.

config_snapshot_id.description: The run-level configuration that produced this reading, so the reading can be explained a year later without archaeology.

utc_timestamp.description: ISO-8601, UTC, with an explicit Z. Enforced by pattern rather than by format, because format is an annotation by default and an annotation is not a refusal. A local-time or offset-bearing timestamp is rejected by the schema alone (Standards Baseline §9).

contribution.description: One named input's contribution, so a reading is explicable from its stored inputs.

dial_reading.description: Reading[T] as a discriminated union: VALUE | DEGRADED | UNKNOWN, mirroring crash_detector.dials.reading exactly. UNKNOWN declares no score property at ALL, so an unknown dial carrying a number is unrepresentable rather than merely discouraged — that is CD-AC-001 held in the schema. additionalProperties is false BOTH here and inside every branch: the parent closure catches an unknown key directly (a sibling of oneOf sees the whole instance), and the branch closure catches a key that is valid for a DIFFERENT state, such as a score smuggled onto an UNKNOWN reading. No range is declared on score, and that is a refusal rather than an omission: a declared range is a declared scale, and the scale of a dial is product meaning owed under CD-D-005 (see CD-ENG-F06). *** detail_level ATTACHES HERE, PER DIAL, AND NOT AT ENVELOPE TOP LEVEL (PO-DECISIONS-0025 ruling 5, which ruled Q29). *** The placement is the doctrine: a SINGLE envelope-level detail_level derived from BOTH readings would require a function consuming the equity magnitude and the monetary magnitude and returning one answer, which is the CD-AC-002 shape reached one step sideways (the output is a level rather than a number). Two dials, two levels, computed separately by crash_detector.publication.detail_level.detail_level_for, which takes ONE reading and ONE dial slot and has no variant taking both. It is REQUIRED in every branch of the union INCLUDING UNKNOWN, and that is the point rather than an oversight: PID §3.2 is constitutional — 'Missing data must never render as calm' — so the branch with no score is exactly the branch that must still say how loudly to render. *** AND THE VALUE IT MAY CARRY THERE IS NARROWED BY THIS DOCUMENT, NOT DELEGATED TO ONE: DEGRADED and UNKNOWN reference #/$defs/absent_data_detail_level, which does not contain calm, so an unknown dial rendering as calm is UNREPRESENTABLE rather than merely forbidden elsewhere. SUPERSEDED AT WO-3 INCREMENT 16A-FIX, STATED AND NOT ERASED: this sentence previously ended 'and DetailPolicy REFUSES CONSTRUCTION when absent_data_level is calm.' That was TRUE OF THAT MODULE AND FALSE AS A CLAIM ABOUT THIS CONTRACT — the envelope never consults DetailPolicy, detail_level_for had zero callers in src/, and an UNKNOWN dial carrying calm was in fact ADMITTED on BOTH surfaces (CD-ASR-WO3-03, RED). A description is not an enforcement point; the claim is now held by the thing that does the refusing. *** An OPTIONAL detail_level would let a renderer meet a dial carrying no level and decide for itself, which is the second decision site the whole module exists to prevent.

dial_reading_value.description: Value(T, as_of_utc, inputs_used). At least one named input: a reading computed from nothing is Unknown, not a value.

dial_reading_degraded.description: Degraded(T, as_of_utc, missing_inputs, reason). Carries a value AND its damage, under a state a renderer must branch on. At least one named missing input: a reading with nothing missing is a Value, not a degradation.

dial_reading_unknown.description: Unknown(reason, since_utc, missing_inputs). NO score property is declared, and additionalProperties is false, so there is nothing here to render as a number because there is no number. missing_inputs may be empty: 'no source is registered' is a real reason with nothing to name.

detail_level.description: Drill-down proportional to risk (PID §4, ratified): 'calm = dial + one line; elevated = the categories carrying the score; acute = everything, ranked by contribution.' The three levels and their ORDER are derived verbatim from that clause; a fourth level is a PID amendment, not a schema edit. The enum is duplicated from crash_detector.publication.detail_level.DETAIL_ORDER and tests/test_detail_level.py asserts the two cannot drift. NO THRESHOLD IS DECLARED HERE OR ANYWHERE: deciding at what score a dial stops being calm requires a dial SCALE, and the scale of a dial is what the dial MEANS, owed under CD-D-005 (Q25). This schema constrains the VOCABULARY, never the boundaries.

absent_data_detail_level.description: *** PID §3.2, CONSTITUTIONAL, AND HELD IN THIS DOCUMENT RATHER THAN DELEGATED: 'Missing data must never render as calm.' *** The #/$defs/detail_level vocabulary MINUS calm. It is the type the DEGRADED and UNKNOWN branches use, and those two are exactly the missing-data states: UNKNOWN declares no score at all, and DEGRADED carries a value AND its damage with at least one named missing input. crash_detector.publication.detail_level.detail_level_for returns policy.absent_data_level for BOTH of them and never a level derived from a score, so a calm on either branch is a document the code cannot produce and the contract must not accept. This is the SAME PATTERN CD-AC-001 already holds one clause over — UNKNOWN declares no score property at all, so an unknown dial carrying a number is unrepresentable — applied to the other constitutional clause, which is what WO-3 increment 16A missed. SUPERSEDED STATE, RECORDED RATHER THAN ERASED: before 16A-FIX both branches referenced #/$defs/detail_level, the guarantee was asserted only in PROSE here and enforced only in DetailPolicy.__post_init__ — a module this envelope never consults — and an UNKNOWN dial carrying calm was ADMITTED by refuse_unless_publishable on BOTH surfaces (CD-ASR-WO3-03, RED; reproduced at BL-20260824T084141Z-0160). With zero registered sources every dial is UNKNOWN, so that was the only state this product could publish. VALUE deliberately keeps the full vocabulary including calm: a genuinely calm reading backed by a real number is the whole reason calm exists, and narrowing it there would satisfy PID §3.2 vacuously by making the dial incapable of ever reading calm. NO THRESHOLD IS DECLARED HERE either; this constrains VOCABULARY, never boundaries.
